description: Read a research job by the `research_id` research_submit returned: `status` (queued, running, completed, failed), `input`, `result` (the brief, once completed) and `error` (once failed). Every brief field is {value, sources, confidence}. `result.social` holds `x` (handle, followers, bio, posting_cadence, recent_topics, notable_posts) and `reddit` (mention_count_90d, top_threads, communities, tone, tone_basis); a platform with nothing found is absent, and with neither `social` is absent. Free; only your own account's jobs are visible.
name: research_get
title: Get Research Brief
